entities.summary: Ghoncheh Ghavami, also spelled as Goncheh Ghavami, is a British-Iranian law graduate of the School of Oriental and African Studies, University of London who was held in solitary confinement in Evin Prison for protesting for equal access to sporting events in Iran.
